name: zclass_window_set_size
description: zClass_Window::gwWindowSetSize validates a window node and stores viewport dimensions.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass window/source-cluster pass because the adjacent window helpers share the same validation shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44f9c0 validates null node, null class-data, and wrong-class old error paths, then stores width at window-data offset 0 and height at offset 4 before returning 0.
The native smoke verifies successful viewport-size storage through the getter and verifies null-node, null-data, and wrong-class return codes.
